Perfecta™ has been developed to deliver a new standard in plant-based eating by addressing the category's most persistent consumer challenges: taste, texture, and the authentic experience of enjoying a whole cut of meat. The product line combines Steakholder Foods' proprietary production technology with premium ingredients to create a range of plant-based offerings designed to closely replicate the sensory experience of conventional meat.

These products feature tender, fibrous textures and marbling-like characteristics that enhance flavor and juiciness while providing consumers with a satisfying plant-based alternative.
“Our launch in the Northeastern United States represents an exciting step forward as Perfecta begins reaching consumers through retail shelves for the first time,” said
Arik Kaufman, Chief Executive Officer of Steakholder Foods

. “We believe the plant-based category is ready for a new generation of products that deliver on taste and eating experience without compromise. We are on track with our launch, and the Northeast is just the beginning of our commercial journey, and we intend to expand both our retail footprint and our distribution network as consumer demand grows.”

The Company's current launch strategy focuses on building awareness and consumer trial throughout the Northeast U.S. market while establishing a foundation for broader expansion across additional regions. Steakholder Foods also intends to pursue relationships with additional distribution partners over time, supporting its objective of making Perfecta products available to a wider range of retailers and consumers nationwide.

Perfecta is positioned as a next-generation plant-based protein platform capable of expanding across multiple protein categories. The brand's portfolio includes both whole-cut and traditional formats, offering consumers premium alternatives designed to better replicate the taste, texture, and appearance of conventional meat and seafood products.
Perfecta™ Premium Plant-Based Meat in a Retail Store

Steakholder Foods is at the forefront of transforming the alternative protein industries through its advanced technology. Founded in 2019, Steakholder Foods is utilizing advanced technologies to revolutionize the food industry, and has officially launched PerfectaTM Premium Plant-Based Meat in the U.S. market in 2026, under the slogan “Plant-Based Meat, Perfected!” Perfecta is positioned as a next-generation, plant-based protein platform, whose launch is planned to begin with a phased rollout in the Northeastern United States, followed by retail expansion as the supply chain and distribution scale.

Steakholder Foods also specializes in developing and selling 3D-printing production machines, supported by proprietary premix blends, formulated from the highest-quality raw ingredients. These innovative tools are designed to help manufacturers of all sizes efficiently produce foods that meet and exceed consumer expectations for taste, texture, and appearance and offer a safe and sustainable alternative to industrialized meat and seafood production.

Steakholder Foods’ expertise lies in creating alternative proteins products that replicate the complex textures of traditional meats such as beef steaks, white fish, shrimp, and eel. The company is also exploring the integration of cultivated cells, preparing for future advancements in food technology.
